use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

use Point = (x: double, y: double)

let plastic = 1.324718D

let colours = [
    (red = 200ub, green = 60ub, blue = 50ub),
    (red = 230ub, green = 170ub, blue = 30ub),
    (red = 40ub, green = 120ub, blue = 200ub),
    (red = 40ub, green = 40ub, blue = 50ub)
]

quarter_arc(image: IMAGE, from: Point, to: Point) is
    let middle = (x = (from.x + to.x) / 2.0D, y = (from.y + to.y) / 2.0D)
    let half = (x = (to.x - from.x) / 2.0D, y = (to.y - from.y) / 2.0D)
    let centre = (x = middle.x + half.y, y = middle.y - half.x)

    let start = Math.atan2(from.y - centre.y, from.x - centre.x)
    let finish = Math.atan2(to.y - centre.y, to.x - centre.x)
    let sweep mut = finish - start

    if sweep > Math.pi then sweep = sweep - 2.0D * Math.pi fi
    if sweep < -Math.pi then sweep = sweep + 2.0D * Math.pi fi

    let size = Math.sqrt(half.x * half.x + half.y * half.y)
    let radius = Math.sqrt(2.0D) * size

    image.line(
        (0::24)
            |> map(i =>
                let a = start + sweep * cast double(i) / 24.0D in
                (x = centre.x + radius * Math.cos(a),
                 y = centre.y + radius * Math.sin(a)))
            |> collect_list())
si

harriss(
    image: IMAGE, at: Point, degrees: double, length: double,
    steps: int, width: double
) is
    let here mut = at
    let angle mut = degrees
    let side mut = length

    for step in 0..steps do
        let radians = angle * Math.pi / 180.0D
        let next = (
            x = here.x + side * Math.cos(radians),
            y = here.y + side * Math.sin(radians))

        let quadrant = cast int(Math.round(angle / 90.0D))
        let colour = colours[(quadrant % 4 + 4) % 4]

        image.colour(colour.red, colour.green, colour.blue)
        image.stroke(width)
        quarter_arc(image, here, next)

        here = next
        angle = angle - 90.0D
        side = side / plastic
    od
si

let image = IMAGE(820, 660)

image.clear(225ub, 225ub, 220ub)

let x = 450.0D
let y = 630.0D
let base = 525.0D / plastic / plastic

scaled(power: int) -> double => base / Math.pow(plastic, cast double(power))

let left = x - (scaled(1) + scaled(3))
let high = y - (base + scaled(2))

let starts = [
    (left, y - scaled(7), 180.0D, scaled(6), 2, 6.0D),
    (left, high, 270.0D, scaled(5), 3, 6.0D),
    (x + scaled(4), high, 270.0D, scaled(5), 3, 6.0D),
    (x + scaled(1), high, 0.0D, scaled(4), 4, 6.0D),
    (x - scaled(4), y - scaled(1), 0.0D, scaled(5), 2, 10.0D),
    (x - scaled(4), y - scaled(3), -270.0D, scaled(4), 3, 12.0D),
    (x - scaled(1), y - scaled(3), 180.0D, scaled(3), 4, 12.0D),
    (x - scaled(1), y - base, 270.0D, scaled(2), 5, 14.0D),
    (x, y - base, 0.0D, scaled(1), 6, 14.0D),
    (x, y, -90.0D, base, 7, 18.0D)
]

for (sx, sy, degrees, length, steps, width) in starts do
    harriss(image, (x = sx, y = sy), degrees, length, steps, width)

write_line("a nest of Harriss spirals, each arc {plastic} times smaller")

image.write("harriss.png")

image.show("harriss.png")
